title: agent-desktop Launches Tool for AI Coding Agents to Control Desktop Computers
summary:
Developers have released a new software package called agent-desktop that enables AI assistants to interact directly with operating systems across macOS, Windows and Linux. The tool allows coding agents to perform end-to-end testing of desktop applications and provides a way for multiple agents to control a single app simultaneously.

The software runs in the background to avoid interrupting the user and utilizes the accessibility tree to navigate applications. It also includes a feature to target specific parts of a window to reduce the number of tokens processed during agent operations. The package is available for installation through the npm registry.
